title: Looney Dunes | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Beachfront Seagrove Stunner with access to bikes and an LSV. Updated for 2026
description_expanded: Book Your Getaway Today & Save! Use Promo Code: LOONEYDUNES20 at checkout for an exclusive introductory rate. For a limited time only. Holiday black out dates apply. Valid for arrival dates 1/20/26 - 4/20/26 Looney Dunes is a rare Gulf-front retreat where sweeping emerald-water views and effortless beach access define every moment of your stay. Situated immediately next to the San Juan Beach Access, step from the door to the sand in under a minute. With panoramic Gulf views and a coveted dune overlook seating area, Looney Dunes delivers one of the most scenic vantage points along 30A. The spacious first-floor living area is designed for gathering and unwinding, featuring a Smart TV, fireplace, and uninterrupted views of the Gulf. The gourmet kitchen is equally impressive, offering modern appliances, generous prep space, and a well-stocked setup for everything from casual breakfasts to full family dinners. Enjoy meals together at the dining table with seating for eight, plus additional seating at the breakfast bar, or take the experience outside to the Gulf-facing patio and balcony for unforgettable sunsets and coastal breezes. Perfectly positioned just minutes from Seaside, Looney Dunes includes access to a six-seater LSV and three Taxi bikes for exploring 30A with ease. Driveway parking accommodates up to three vehicles, and nearby Santa Clara Regional Beach Access offers beach service and catered bonfires just a short walk away. This Gulf-front home blends location, comfort, and coastal charm for an exceptional beach getaway. Looney Dunes Features Gulf front home with panoramic Gulf views Immediately next to the San Juan Beach Access. Walk from door to sand in a minute Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. Access to a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Must sign waiver for access to vehicle Enjoy 3 Taxi bikes, perfect for exploring 30A Spacious main living area on the 1st floor with a Smart TV, fireplace, and incredible Gulf views Gourmet kitchen with a view. Enjoy modern appliances and a well-stocked kitchen for cooking. Dining area with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 2 Outdoor dining on the Gulf facing patio and balcony Seating area on dune overlook - a rare view along 30A Driveway parking for 2 vehicles 1st Floor Laundry Room Cable and WIFI 3 min LSV drive to Seaside 2 min LSV drive to Goatfeathers Seafood Market, home of the caught-that-day steamed and seasoned Gulf shrimp. Go early because they do sell out. Beach service and catered bonfires available at nearby Santa Clara Regional Beach Access, only a 2-minute walk from the home Concierge services available including additional bike rentals, grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and more At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee * One promotion or discount per reservation. Promotions or discounts cannot be combined ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
